title: The only 2-critical graph is $K_2$
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite, nonempty vertex set. Then $G$ is $2$-critical if and only if $G$ is isomorphic to the complete graph $K_2$ on two vertices.
replaced:
Second case (B\&M \S{}8.1, verbatim). \emph{\dots{} the only 2-critical graph is
\texttt{K$_{2}$} \dots{}}
